entry_points.name: driver 0.9.0 release candidate qualification
entry_points.trace: The v0.9.0 candidate SHA 2efd7b54 pins workspace version = 0.9.0 (Cargo.toml:11) and was tagged and published: oracledb 0.9.0 is live on crates.io (2026-07-21). All direct train-090 blockers of 5jdu are closed except b13a (TTC-129), which is the pre-authorized operator-deferral exception per the 2026-07-21 no-stall ruling recorded in bead 5swy.

limitations: This close records the qualification of the 0.9.0 minor candidate; the immutable crates.io publication and git tag are the external evidence (manually verified), not a committed machine artifact in this doc. b13a remains a deferred, pre-authorized exception.
